newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares close strong session at new high.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares close strong session at new high.

text.p: Dutch shares showed persistent strength throughout the session on Wednesday, with the AEX index of 25 blue chip issues eventually setting a new closing high.
The index closed 9.27 points or 1.36 percent higher at 689.49, beating the previous record close of 685.02 from January 23 by over four points.
Dealers reported good investor demand for shares, with prices supported by a firm dollar, higher bond prices and further gains for Wall Street stocks.
Royal Dutch Petroleum closed 8.40 guilders higher at 331.60 buoyed by recent strength in sterling, its accounting currency.
Dealers said Royal Dutch's ascent was assisted by a research note from ABN AMRO pointing out the positive effect of sterling's gains on the firm's earnings per share in guilders.

But Philips Electronics closed 0.20 lower at 75.90 amid some selling pressure ahead of fourth quarter results next week. Dealers said some investors sold stock to protect themselves against a possible adverse reaction to the numbers.

Dealers said investors seemed to have cast off much of their earlier caution -- rooted in fears that prices would have to fall after such an extended rally -- and appeared now to have greater confidence that the bull market was sustainable.
